chunks: Sufficient is Allah and His Word as perfection.
For the believers who have faith and are God-conscious.

key_terms.وَكَلِمَتِهِ: and His Word (referring to the Quran or divine speech)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah and His Word are the perfection of the believers?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this hadith to anchor the doctrine of *Ghaybah* (Occultation) by asserting that divine perfection remains intact through the preservation of the Quran and the Imams, even during periods of political absence. This links the theological concept of *Kamal* (perfection) directly to the enduring qualities of *Iman* and *Taqwa*, reassuring the Shia community that spiritual completeness is not contingent on visible leadership but on the continuity of divine guidance.
